    Release notes¶

    rn_forge.devops.notes ¶

    Release notes: a changelog section and the umbrella release for a shipped page.

    Umbrella(tag, title, body) dataclass ¶

    The GitHub release that announces a shipped release page.

    body instance-attribute ¶

    The release notes: the page's ## Shipped section and a link to the page.

    tag instance-attribute ¶

    The release tag, for example release-6.

    title instance-attribute ¶

    The page's H1 text.

    changelog_section(changelog, version) ¶

    Return the body under ## [<version>] up to the next ## [ heading.

    The heading is ## [<version>] followed by the end of the line or - <date>; the version must match exactly.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    changelog str

    The text of a Keep a Changelog file.

    		 required
    version str

    The version whose section to return.

    		 required

    Returns:

    Type Description
    str

    The section body with surrounding whitespace removed.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    ValueError

    The version has no heading, or its body is empty.

    pending_umbrella(releases_dir, existing_tags, site_url) ¶

    Return the umbrella release for the newest shipped release page.

    Only the newest page whose | **Status** | row starts with shipped is considered, so older pages are never backfilled.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    releases_dir Path

    A directory of release-<n>/index.md pages.

    		 required
    existing_tags Collection[str]

    The repository's existing tag names.

    		 required
    site_url str

    The documentation site's URL, ending in /.

    		 required

    Returns:

    Type Description
    Umbrella | None

    The umbrella release, or None when no page is shipped or its tag
    Umbrella | None

    already exists.
